input.summary: Add assignment consent standard: Company free to assign to affiliates/successors; HDI needs our consent and may not assign to a competitor.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 is only a successors-and-assigns clause, so HDI could today assign this Agreement to anyone, including a competitor of ours, without notice or consent. We have added a consent standard that keeps our freedom to assign to an affiliate or to a successor by merger or sale of assets while requiring our (not unreasonably withheld) consent to an HDI assignment. If preferred, we can accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed), and in no event to a competitor of the Company. The Company may assign this Agreement without HDI's consent to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate, re-price or suspend this Agreement.
